punchline: In Roam's toolbox every question has its own picture: who gets a portrait, when gets a timeline.
thirty_sec: Dan Roam suggests picking a side in five pairs of opposites before drawing: simple or elaborate, quality or quantity, vision or execution, individual or comparison, change or status quo. You can run them in order or weight each toward the audience. Six questions each have a matching picture: portrait, chart, map, timeline, flowchart and multiple-variable plot.
